Deciding whether to buy St. Charles Place.

Cash is $1500. The pink group has three properties total, and I own none. I am checking the opponent's holdings to gauge auction risk.

The opponent owns one pink property, States Avenue. Neither player holds the pink monopoly yet. St. Charles Place costs $140, a small fraction of the cash on hand.

The pink group is a solid mid-game target with a $100 house cost and strong rent scale. Blocking the opponent from completing the set is valuable, though finishing the color group will require trading for Virginia. Standard strategy favors buying every property landed on early, especially under $200. The $140 price makes this a clear buy.
